_note: Controller aim assist (src/game/aimassist.ts). The game does not publish its aim assist code, so these are its known settings where they are known and ours where they are not. Rotational strength 0.4 is the PC controller value Respawn has stated (console was 0.6 until Season 20 brought it to 0.4 too). The slowdown and the zone size are ours, chosen so a stick correction on a target does not overshoot without the pad tracking by itself. Mouse input is never assisted.
_rotational: While the stick or the movement keys are in use, the view follows this share of the target's own angular movement across the screen (its strafe, or yours around it). Zero input, zero assist: it never tracks on its own.
_rotationalAds: the same share aimed down the sights (the legacy game has one number for both; SpeedKills keeps them apart so either can be tuned)
_rotationalMaxDeg: a larger jump in the target's bearing in one frame is a teleport or a respawn, not movement to follow
_slowdown: The look speed with the reticle inside the zone: 1 is none. Aiming down sights slows more.
_zone: The zone is a sphere of this radius (metres) round the target's chest, so it covers less of the screen the further away the target is.
_falloff: metres: full strength (slowdown and rotation both) up to falloffStart, easing to none at maxRange, so a far target is the player's own aim
_sticky: no snapping: once a target is held, the assist stays on it while it is still in its zone, even if another comes nearer the reticle; a new target needs the reticle to leave the old one's zone
